rows.definition: The read-only native geometry predicate for one checked BF16 publication row. It requires a positive count within INT32_MAX, a nonzero device X workgroup limit, a checked four-byte-per-element extent representable by host and Vulkan sizes, and compliance with any nonzero device buffer-byte cap including the 16-byte status buffer. The grid-stride shader uses the smaller of ceil(count/64) and that workgroup limit.
rows.distinction: This checks dispatch geometry before the Go adapter allocates output and status. It does not check pipeline availability, inspect tensor values, initialize status, dispatch arithmetic or qualify hardware; those have separate checks and evidence. The BF16 witness native define controls whether this symbol is compiled, while this predicate bounds the requested row.
